<!doctype html>
<html lang="en">
<head>
<meta charset="utf-8">
<meta name="viewport" content="width=device-width, initial-scale=1">
<title>Kyrgyz Student Association — Rowan University</title>
<meta name="description" content="KSA brings together Kyrgyz students at Rowan and everyone curious about Kyrgyzstan.">

<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com">
<link rel="preconnect" href="https://fonts.gstatic.com" crossorigin>
<link rel="stylesheet" href="https://fonts.googleapis.com/css2?family=Manrope:wght@400;500;600;700&family=Unbounded:wght@600;700;800&display=swap">
<style>
#links{min-height:100vh;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;font-family:'Manrope',system-ui,sans-serif;color:#2A1A14}
#links *{box-sizing:border-box}
#links .hero{width:100%;background:#A3161C;border-radius:0 0 32px 32px;padding:48px 24px 40px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;align-items:center;gap:18px;text-align:center}
#links .eyebrow{font-size:12px;font-weight:700;letter-spacing:2px;color:#F2B134}
#links .hero h1{margin:0;font-family:'Unbounded','Manrope',sans-serif;font-weight:700;font-size:30px;line-height:1.15;color:#FBF3E8}
#links .hero p{margin:0;font-size:15px;line-height:1.55;color:#F6E4D3;max-width:330px}
#links .txt{display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:10px;align-items:center}
#links .list{width:100%;max-width:440px;padding:28px 20px 36px;display:flex;flex-direction:column;gap:12px}
#links .lk{min-height:58px;padding:0 22px;border-radius:999px;background:#FBF3E8;border:1px solid #E3CFB4;color:#2A1A14;font-weight:600;font-size:16px;display:flex;align-items:center;justify-content:space-between;gap:12px;transition:transform .15s ease,box-shadow .15s ease}
#links .lk:hover{transform:translateY(-2px);box-shadow:0 6px 16px rgba(80,20,20,.14)}
#links .lk.main{background:#A3161C;border-color:#A3161C;color:#FBF3E8;font-weight:700}
#links .lk svg{flex:none}
#links .foot{margin:20px 0 0;text-align:center;font-size:13px;color:#6B5648}
html:not([data-view="site"]) #site{display:none}
html[data-view="site"] #links{display:none}
:root{--eagle:url(data:image/png;base64,)}.eg{background:var(--eagle) center / contain no-repeat}
body{margin:0;background:#F3E8D8}
html{scroll-behavior:smooth}
a{text-decoration:none}
.nv{color:#2A1A14}
.nv:hover{color:#A5151C}
.bt{transition:transform .15s ease}
.bt:hover{transform:translateY(-2px)}
a:focus-visible{outline:2px solid #2A1A14;outline-offset:3px}
</style>
</head>
<body>
<div id="site">
<div style="box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; background: #F3E8D8; font-family: 'Manrope', system-ui, sans-serif; color: #2A1A14">

  <!-- NAV -->
  <div style="box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; background: #F3E8D8; border-bottom: 1px solid #E3CFB4">
    <div style="box-sizing: border-box; max-width: 1100px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 12px clamp(20px, 8.4vw, 72px); display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 12px 24px">
      <a href="#links" style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 10px; color: #2A1A14">
        <span style="width: 40px; height: 40px; border-radius: 20px; background: #A3161C; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center"><span class="eg" role="presentation" style="width: 26px; height: 24px; display: block"></span></span>
        <span style="font-family: 'Unbounded', 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 16px">KSA</span>
      </a>
      <div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 8px 22px; font-size: 14px; font-weight: 500">
        <a class="nv" href="#mission">Mission</a>
        <a class="nv" href="#past">Past events</a>
        <a class="nv" href="#calendar">Calendar</a>
        <a class="nv" href="#board">Board</a>
        <a class="bt" href="#join" style="background: #A3161C; color: #FBF3E8; font-weight: 600; padding: 9px 20px; border-radius: 999px">Join</a>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- HERO -->
  <div id="top" style="box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; background: #A3161C">
    <div style="box-sizing: border-box; max-width: 1100px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 64px clamp(20px, 8.4vw, 72px) 72px; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; justify-content: space-between; gap: 40px">
      <div style="flex: 1 1 480px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 22px; min-width: 0">
        <span style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 2px; color: #F2B134">ABOUT THE CLUB · ROWAN UNIVERSITY</span>
        <h1 style="margin: 0; font-family: 'Unbounded', 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: clamp(34px, 6.4vw, 60px); line-height: 1.05; color: #FBF3E8">Kyrgyz Student Association</h1>
        <p style="margin: 0; font-size: 16px; line-height: 1.65; color: #FBF3E8; max-width: 340px">KSA brings together Kyrgyz students at Rowan and everyone curious about Kyrgyzstan. We celebrate our holidays, share our food and music, and help new students settle into life at Rowan and in America. Open to all majors and backgrounds.</p>
        <div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px">
          <a class="bt" href="#" style="background: #FBF3E8; color: #2A1A14; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px; padding: 14px clamp(20px, 8.4vw, 72px); border-radius: 999px">Join KSA on ProfLink</a>
          <a class="bt" href="#calendar" style="border: 1px solid #F2B134; color: #FBF3E8; font-weight: 600; font-size: 14px; padding: 13px clamp(20px, 8.4vw, 72px); border-radius: 999px">Upcoming events</a>
        </div>
      </div>
      <div style="flex: 0 1 260px; display: flex; justify-content: center">
        <div class="eg" role="img" aria-label="KSA emblem: eagle with sun" style="width: clamp(130px, 20vw, 210px); aspect-ratio: 493 / 462"></div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- MISSION -->
  <div id="mission" style="box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; background: #F3E8D8">
    <div style="box-sizing: border-box; max-width: 1100px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 72px clamp(20px, 8.4vw, 72px); display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; gap: 28px; text-align: center">
      <span style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 2px; color: #A3161C">OUR MISSION</span>
      <h2 style="margin: 0; font-family: 'Unbounded', 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: clamp(24px, 4vw, 38px); line-height: 1.2; max-width: 640px">To keep Kyrgyz culture alive on campus and make every student feel at home.</h2>
      <div style="width: 100%; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px; text-align: left; margin-top: 12px">
        <div style="flex: 1 1 260px; box-sizing: border-box; background: #FBF3E8; border: 1px solid #E3CFB4; border-radius: 20px; padding: 24px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px">
          <h3 style="margin: 0; font-family: 'Unbounded', 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; color: #A3161C">Share the culture</h3>
          <p style="margin: 0; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6">Celebrate Nooruz and other traditions, and share Kyrgyz food, music and language with the Rowan community.</p>
        </div>
        <div style="flex: 1 1 260px; box-sizing: border-box; background: #FBF3E8; border: 1px solid #E3CFB4; border-radius: 20px; padding: 24px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px">
          <h3 style="margin: 0; font-family: 'Unbounded', 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; color: #A3161C">Support students</h3>
          <p style="margin: 0; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6">Help new and international students find their footing at Rowan and in everyday life in America.</p>
        </div>
        <div style="flex: 1 1 260px; box-sizing: border-box; background: #FBF3E8; border: 1px solid #E3CFB4; border-radius: 20px; padding: 24px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px">
          <h3 style="margin: 0; font-family: 'Unbounded', 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px; color: #A3161C">Build community</h3>
          <p style="margin: 0; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6">Connect Kyrgyz students across universities and with the wider Kyrgyz community in New Jersey.</p>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- PAST EVENTS -->
  <div id="past" style="box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; background: #E8D9C0">
    <div style="box-sizing: border-box; max-width: 1100px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 72px clamp(20px, 8.4vw, 72px); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px">
      <span style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 2px; color: #A3161C">WHAT WE’VE DONE</span>
      <h2 style="margin: 0 0 14px; font-family: 'Unbounded', 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: clamp(28px, 5vw, 42px)">Past events</h2>
      <div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 16px">
        <div style="flex: 1 1 280px; box-sizing: border-box; background: #F3E8D8; border-radius: 20px; overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-direction: column">
          <div style="height: 240px; background: #A3161C; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #FBF3E8; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500">Event photo</div>
          <div style="padding: 20px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px">
            <span style="font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 1.5px; color: #A3161C">SPRING · [YEAR]</span>
            <h3 style="margin: 0; font-family: 'Unbounded', 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px">Nooruz Celebration</h3>
            <p style="margin: 0; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6">Our biggest night: 200+ guests from four universities, with Rowan’s president and Kyrgyz UN representatives in attendance.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div style="flex: 1 1 280px; box-sizing: border-box; background: #F3E8D8; border-radius: 20px; overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-direction: column">
          <div style="height: 240px; background: #C9A585; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #4A1A14; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500">Event photo</div>
          <div style="padding: 20px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px">
            <span style="font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 1.5px; color: #A3161C">FALL · 2026</span>
            <h3 style="margin: 0; font-family: 'Unbounded', 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px">Welcome Freshmen</h3>
            <p style="margin: 0; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6">A welcome night for new students — club intro, a Rowan survival guide and practical tips for life in America.</p>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div style="flex: 1 1 280px; box-sizing: border-box; background: #F3E8D8; border-radius: 20px; overflow: hidden; display: flex; flex-direction: column">
          <div style="height: 240px; background: #7D0E12; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #FBF3E8; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 500">Event photo</div>
          <div style="padding: 20px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 8px">
            <span style="font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 1.5px; color: #A3161C">[DATE]</span>
            <h3 style="margin: 0; font-family: 'Unbounded', 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 18px">[EVENT NAME]</h3>
            <p style="margin: 0; font-size: 14px; line-height: 1.6">[Short description of the event.]</p>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- UPCOMING / CALENDAR -->
  <div id="calendar" style="box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; background: #7D0E12">
    <div style="box-sizing: border-box; max-width: 1100px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 64px clamp(20px, 8.4vw, 72px); display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px">
      <span style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 2px; color: #F2B134">COMING UP</span>
      <h2 style="margin: 0 0 12px; font-family: 'Unbounded', 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: clamp(28px, 5vw, 42px); color: #FBF3E8">Upcoming events</h2>

      <div style="box-sizing: border-box; background: #5A0A0E; border-radius: 14px; padding: 16px; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: flex-start; gap: 20px 28px">
        <img src="data:image/jpeg;base64," alt="Flyer: Student Meetup with Kahoot and Jeopardy, October 28, Room 255, 7:00 pm" width="720" height="951" style="flex: 0 1 320px; width: 100%; max-width: 320px; height: auto; border-radius: 12px; display: block">
        <div style="flex: 1 1 260px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 16px; min-width: 0">
          <div style="display: flex; align-items: center; gap: 14px">
            <div style="flex: none; width: 52px; height: 52px; border-radius: 10px; background: #F2B134; color: #5A0A0E; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; line-height: 1.1">
              <span style="font-size: 10px; font-weight: 700">OCT</span>
              <span style="font-family: 'Unbounded', 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 17px">28</span>
            </div>
            <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 4px">
              <span style="font-size: 11px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 1.5px; color: #F2B134">WEDNESDAY · 7:00 PM</span>
              <h3 style="margin: 0; font-family: 'Unbounded', 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 22px; line-height: 1.2; color: #FBF3E8">Student Meetup</h3>
            </div>
          </div>
          <p style="margin: 0; font-size: 15px; line-height: 1.65; color: #F6E4D3">Hello everyone! We’re planning a student meetup with games — Kahoot and Jeopardy. Games, friends and good vibes. See you there!</p>
          <div style="display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 6px; font-size: 14px; color: #E9CFC4">
            <span><strong style="color: #FBF3E8">When:</strong> October 28, 7:00 pm</span>
            <span><strong style="color: #FBF3E8">Where:</strong> Room 255</span>
          </div>
          <div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 10px">
            <a class="bt" href="https://www.instagram.com/ksa.rowan/" target="_blank" rel="noopener noreferrer" style="border: 1px solid #F2B134; color: #F2B134; font-size: 13px; font-weight: 600; padding: 10px 20px; border-radius: 999px">Details on Instagram</a>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <div style="box-sizing: border-box; background: #5A0A0E; border-radius: 14px; padding: 12px 16px; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 12px 16px">
        <div style="width: 46px; height: 46px; border-radius: 10px; background: #F2B134; color: #5A0A0E; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; line-height: 1.1">
          <span style="font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700">[MON]</span>
          <span style="font-family: 'Unbounded', 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px">[DD]</span>
        </div>
        <div style="flex: 1 1 200px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px">
          <span style="font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; color: #FBF3E8">[EVENT NAME]</span>
          <span style="font-size: 14px; color: #E9CFC4">[TIME] · [LOCATION]</span>
        </div>
        <a class="bt" href="#" style="border: 1px solid #F2B134; color: #F2B134; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; padding: 8px 18px; border-radius: 999px">RSVP</a>
      </div>

      <div style="box-sizing: border-box; background: #5A0A0E; border-radius: 14px; padding: 12px 16px; display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; align-items: center; gap: 12px 16px">
        <div style="width: 46px; height: 46px; border-radius: 10px; background: #F2B134; color: #5A0A0E; display: flex; flex-direction: column; align-items: center; justify-content: center; line-height: 1.1">
          <span style="font-size: 9px; font-weight: 700">MAR</span>
          <span style="font-family: 'Unbounded', 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 14px">[DD]</span>
        </div>
        <div style="flex: 1 1 200px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 3px">
          <span style="font-size: 17px; font-weight: 600; color: #FBF3E8">Nooruz 2027</span>
          <span style="font-size: 14px; color: #E9CFC4">[TIME] · [LOCATION]</span>
        </div>
        <a class="bt" href="#" style="border: 1px solid #F2B134; color: #F2B134; font-size: 12px; font-weight: 600; padding: 8px 18px; border-radius: 999px">RSVP</a>
      </div>
    </div>
  </div>

  <!-- BOARD -->
  <div id="board" style="box-sizing: border-box; width: 100%; background: #F3E8D8">
    <div style="box-sizing: border-box; max-width: 1100px; margin: 0 auto; padding: 64px clamp(20px, 8.4vw, 72px) 40px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 14px">
      <span style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; letter-spacing: 2px; color: #A3161C">THE PEOPLE BEHIND KSA</span>
      <h2 style="margin: 0 0 8px; font-family: 'Unbounded', 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-weight: 800; font-size: clamp(28px, 5vw, 42px)">Board</h2>

      <h3 style="margin: 12px 0 0; font-family: 'Unbounded', 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; color: #A3161C">Founders</h3>
      <div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px">
        <div style="flex: 1 1 300px; box-sizing: border-box; background: #A3161C; border-radius: 20px; padding: 10px 10px 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px">
          <div style="aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; border-radius: 14px; background: #8B1218; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #FBF3E8; font-size: 12px">Photo</div>
          <div style="padding: 0 6px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px">
            <span style="font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: #FBF3E8">Begimai Azizova</span>
            <span style="font-size: 14px; color: #F6E4D3">Founder</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div style="flex: 1 1 300px; box-sizing: border-box; background: #A3161C; border-radius: 20px; padding: 10px 10px 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 12px">
          <div style="aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; border-radius: 14px; background: #8B1218; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #FBF3E8; font-size: 12px">Photo</div>
          <div style="padding: 0 6px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px">
            <span style="font-size: 15px; font-weight: 700; color: #FBF3E8">[NAME]</span>
            <span style="font-size: 14px; color: #F6E4D3">Co-founder</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <h3 style="margin: 28px 0 0; font-family: 'Unbounded', 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; color: #A3161C">Current board · 2026-27</h3>
      <div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px">
        <div style="flex: 1 1 200px; box-sizing: border-box; background: #FBF3E8; border: 1px solid #E3CFB4; border-radius: 16px; padding: 10px 10px 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px">
          <div style="aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; border-radius: 12px; background: #E2C9A5; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #7D0E12; font-size: 12px">Photo</div>
          <div style="padding: 0 4px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px">
            <span style="font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700">[NAME]</span>
            <span style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: #7D0E12">President</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div style="flex: 1 1 200px; box-sizing: border-box; background: #FBF3E8; border: 1px solid #E3CFB4; border-radius: 16px; padding: 10px 10px 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px">
          <div style="aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; border-radius: 12px; background: #E2C9A5; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #7D0E12; font-size: 12px">Photo</div>
          <div style="padding: 0 4px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px">
            <span style="font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700">[NAME]</span>
            <span style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: #7D0E12">Vice President</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div style="flex: 1 1 200px; box-sizing: border-box; background: #FBF3E8; border: 1px solid #E3CFB4; border-radius: 16px; padding: 10px 10px 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px">
          <div style="aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; border-radius: 12px; background: #E2C9A5; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #7D0E12; font-size: 12px">Photo</div>
          <div style="padding: 0 4px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px">
            <span style="font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700">[NAME]</span>
            <span style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: #7D0E12">Treasurer</span>
          </div>
        </div>
        <div style="flex: 1 1 200px; box-sizing: border-box; background: #FBF3E8; border: 1px solid #E3CFB4; border-radius: 16px; padding: 10px 10px 16px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 10px">
          <div style="aspect-ratio: 1 / 1; border-radius: 12px; background: #E2C9A5; display: flex; align-items: center; justify-content: center; color: #7D0E12; font-size: 12px">Photo</div>
          <div style="padding: 0 4px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px">
            <span style="font-size: 14px; font-weight: 700">[NAME]</span>
            <span style="font-size: 12px; font-weight: 700; color: #7D0E12">Marketing Lead</span>
          </div>
        </div>
      </div>

      <h3 style="margin: 28px 0 0; font-family: 'Unbounded', 'Manrope', sans-serif; font-weight: 700; font-size: 15px; color: #5A4438">Past board · 2025-26</h3>
      <div style="display: flex; flex-wrap: wrap; gap: 12px">
        <div style="flex: 1 1 200px; box-sizing: border-box; background: #E8D9C0; border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 14px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px">
          <span style="font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600">[NAME]</span>
          <span style="font-size: 12px; color: #5A4438">President</span>
        </div>
        <div style="flex: 1 1 200px; box-sizing: border-box; background: #E8D9C0; border-radius: 12px; padding: 12px 14px; display: flex; flex-direction: column; gap: 2px">
          <span style="font-size: 14px; font-weight: 600">[NAME]</span>
          <span style="font-size: 12px; color: #5A4438">Vice President</span>
        </div>

<script>
(function () {
  function route() {
    var id = location.hash.slice(1);
    var el = id ? document.getElementById(id) : null;
    var site = document.getElementById('site');
    var isSite = id === 'site' || !!(el && site && site.contains(el));
    document.documentElement.setAttribute('data-view', isSite ? 'site' : 'links');
    if (isSite && el) { setTimeout(function () { el.scrollIntoView(); }, 0); }
    else { window.scrollTo(0, 0); }
  }
  window.addEventListener('hashchange', route);
  route();
})();
</script>
